messages:
kyle: Morning async — quick pipeline check (what I did / blockers / today). Did: macrohealth demo + shared SOW. Blocker: MacroHealth asking for HSM/KMS integration details (keywrap + attestation). Need security signoff and an IP allowlist for Dedicated pilot. Today: follow up w/ security + schedule pilot kickoff. @maria can you share the customer contact and the HSM spec?

maria: shared contact in DM and uploaded MacroHealth HSM spec to the deal doc (link: https://drive.redwood.co/mb/macrohealth-hsm). I also asked them to confirm if bring-your-own-key required.

devon: noted the ask. For Dedicated we need: 1) customer source IPs, 2) KMS key format (RSA-KW or AES-KW?), 3) expected QPS. Quick snippet of allowed config we use:
```
network:
  allowlist_ips: ["203.0.113.45"]
kms:
  key_type: "RSA-KW"
```
I can draft the network ACL + KMS requirements doc today.

samira: @kyle @devon adding security checklist: - KMS policy + key rotation cadence - HSM attestation/PEM export rules - Access provisioning (least-privilege) - Logging & audit retention (30d default) Filed SEC ticket for MacroHealth: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-5421. Will review uploaded spec by EOD. :white_check_mark:

patrick: quick eng ping — PR #342 needs a review for the Dedicated bootstrap script (netpolicy + kms hooks). I'm OOO after 3pm so if someone can approve or leave comments pm me. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/342

kyle: thanks all. Next steps: maria to confirm BYOK vs managed keys, devon to drop network ACL draft, samira will post security checklist comments in SEC-5421, patrick / eng to triage PR #342. I’ll update the tracker and ping MacroHealth tomorrow morning. :thumbsup: 

sec-bot: Incident-free check: no policy blockers flagged for customer domain macrohealth.io. Reminder: run preflight scan when ACLs are ready.

maria: scheduled a 30m sync with MacroHealth for tomorrow 10:30 PT and invited devon + samira. Dropped contact email in thread.

kyle: perfect — closing my async. If anything urgent ping me in #sales or DM.
